data.raw_text:
Eyewitness footage showed huge waves in Quy Nhon, Vietnam on Thursday Nov. 6, ahead of Typhoon Kalmaegi making landfall.

The storm has already killed 114 in the Philippines with another 127 still missing.

In Vietnam's Gia Lai province, some 350,000 people were expected to have been evacuated by the middle of the day as authorities warned of heavy rains and damaging winds that could cause flooding in low-lying areas and disrupt agricultural activity.

Vietnam has been forced to shut down six airports as Typhoon Kalmaegi approached landfall in the country's central regions, the government said in a statement.

Courtesy: Chai Village Hotel via Reuters
